name: security-pypi-trusted-publishing-review
intent: PyPI trusted publisher OIDC identity and release artifact selection
artifacts: Publisher registration, repository/workflow/environment claims and build/publish job artifact flow.
trace: Follow accepted OIDC claims to project publication authority and ensure the uploaded distribution is from the approved immutable build.
experiment: Use a local policy fixture or owned test repository without public publication; compare intended workflow identity and a claim/artifact mismatch.
disproof: An OIDC token request or PyPI project name in config is not a successful publishing grant.
repair: Constrain publisher claims and artifact promotion, preserving intended release and rejecting mismatched contexts.
branch_decisions: Match the registered publisher repository, workflow and environment to the OIDC identity allowed to mint the upload token. A successful build is not evidence it selected the artifact eventually uploaded. Inspect reusable-workflow and artifact handoffs; a correctly rejected mismatch is a publisher-binding control, not proof that release contents are trustworthy.
